company_source.quote: Levi Strauss & Co. (NYSE: LEVI) will host a conference call to discuss the company's financial results for the third quarter ended August 30, 2026. The call will be held on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at 2 p.m. Pacific Time / 5 p.m. Eastern Time
company_source.detail: the release gives no session wording for the results themselves - only 'To access the company's related press release on October 7, 2026' - so the session is taken from the 17:00 ET call time (>= 16:00 -> AMC)
company_source.how: company Q4 press-release feed investors.levistrauss.com/feed/PressRelease.svc/GetPressReleaseList (HTTP 200, item dated 09/23/2026 09:00:00) and the detail page itself (HTTP 200, dated September 23, 2026)
